LEGAL_DMCA_META_DESCRIPTION: Snipp's DMCA and takedown policy. Learn how to report copyright infringement and request content removal.
LEGAL_DMCA_INTRO: Snipp.gg respects intellectual property rights. If you believe content hosted on the Platform infringes your rights, please follow the process below. We may remove or disable access to allegedly infringing material and, where appropriate, suspend repeat infringers.
LEGAL_DMCA_FILE_NOTICE_HEADING: How to File a Takedown Notice
LEGAL_DMCA_NOTICE_ITEM_WORK_ID: Identification of the copyrighted work you claim is infringed.
LEGAL_DMCA_NOTICE_ITEM_URLS: The exact URL(s) on Snipp.gg where the infringing material appears.
LEGAL_DMCA_NOTICE_ITEM_GOOD_FAITH: A statement that you have a good-faith belief the use is not authorised by the rights owner, its agent, or the law.
LEGAL_DMCA_NOTICE_ITEM_ACCURACY: A statement that the information is accurate and, under penalty of perjury, that you are authorised to act for the rights owner.
LEGAL_DMCA_NOTICE_ITEM_SIGNATURE: Your electronic signature (typing your full legal name is acceptable by email).
LEGAL_DMCA_COUNTER_NOTICE_INTRO: If your content was removed and you believe this was a mistake or misidentification, email a counter-notice to {email} including:
LEGAL_DMCA_COUNTER_ITEM_MATERIAL_ID: Identification of the material that was removed and the URL where it appeared before removal.
LEGAL_DMCA_COUNTER_ITEM_GOOD_FAITH: A statement, under penalty of perjury, that you have a good-faith belief the material was removed due to mistake or misidentification.
LEGAL_DMCA_COUNTER_ITEM_CONSENT: Your consent to receive further communication regarding the matter.
LEGAL_DMCA_REPEAT_INFRINGERS_BODY: Accounts of users who repeatedly infringe may be suspended or terminated.
LEGAL_DMCA_AFTER_NOTICE_ITEM_REVIEW: We review the notice for completeness.
LEGAL_DMCA_AFTER_NOTICE_ITEM_REMOVE: We may remove or disable access to the reported material.
LEGAL_DMCA_AFTER_NOTICE_ITEM_NOTIFY: We notify the uploader (when possible) and may share the notice with them.
LEGAL_DMCA_AFTER_NOTICE_ITEM_RESTORE: If we receive a valid counter-notice, we may restore the content unless the complainant informs us of legal action.
LEGAL_DMCA_SEND_TO_EMAIL: All DMCA notices and counter-notices should be sent to {email}.
LEGAL_DMCA_MISREPRESENTATION_BODY: Submitting false or bad-faith notices or counter-notices may have legal consequences. Only submit a notice if you are certain your claim is valid.
LEGAL_GDPR_META_DESCRIPTION: Your data rights under GDPR. Learn how to request, export, or delete your personal data on Snipp.
LEGAL_GDPR_INTRO: If you are located in the European Economic Area (EEA), United Kingdom, or Switzerland, you have rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) regarding your personal data. This page explains your rights and how to exercise them.
LEGAL_GDPR_RIGHT_ACCESS_TEXT: You can request a copy of your personal data we hold.
LEGAL_GDPR_RIGHT_RECTIFICATION_TEXT: You can ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
LEGAL_GDPR_RIGHT_ERASURE_TEXT: You can request deletion of your data (“right to be forgotten”).
LEGAL_GDPR_RIGHT_RESTRICTION_TEXT: You can ask us to restrict processing of your data in certain circumstances.
LEGAL_GDPR_RIGHT_OBJECTION_TEXT: You can object to our processing of your data for certain purposes.
LEGAL_GDPR_RIGHT_PORTABILITY_TEXT: You can request your data in a portable format.
LEGAL_GDPR_RIGHT_WITHDRAW_CONSENT_TEXT: If processing is based on consent, you may withdraw it at any time.
LEGAL_GDPR_RIGHT_COMPLAIN_TEXT: You have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.
LEGAL_GDPR_EXERCISE_RIGHTS_BODY: To exercise any of these rights, please email {email} with your request. We may need to verify your identity before fulfilling your request.
LEGAL_GDPR_LAWFUL_BASIS_BODY: We process your data based on one or more of the following legal grounds: your consent, performance of a contract, compliance with legal obligations, or our legitimate interests.
LEGAL_GDPR_INTERNATIONAL_TRANSFERS_BODY: If your data is transferred outside the EEA/UK, we take steps to ensure it is protected, such as using standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission.
LEGAL_GDPR_CONTACT_BODY: For any questions or concerns about your data or this policy, contact us at {email}.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_META_DESCRIPTION: Learn how Snipp collects, uses, and protects your personal information. Read our full privacy policy.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_INTRO: We value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use Snipp.gg (the “Platform”). If you do not agree with this policy, please do not use the Platform.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_INFO_STORED_INTRO: We collect and store the following information to operate the Platform:
LEGAL_PRIVACY_INFO_EMAIL_TEXT: Collected when you sign in via magic link to identify your account.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_INFO_USER_ID_TEXT: A unique ID for your account.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_INFO_API_KEY_TEXT: If you create one in the Developer Console.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_INFO_STRIPE_ID_TEXT: Your Stripe customer and/or subscription identifier.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_INFO_SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS_T: Indicates whether you are subscribed to Snipp+.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_INFO_ACCOUNT_CREATED_TEXT: Timestamp of when your account was created.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_USAGE_DEVICE_BODY: When you access the Platform, we may collect limited technical data such as IP address, browser type, device information, time zone, and interaction events (e.g., uploads, errors). This helps us secure the service, prevent abuse, and improve performance.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_UPLOADS_STORAGE_P1: Uploaded files are stored in {r2}. All files are encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM encryption. Files are transmitted over HTTPS. Each file is associated with your user ID in metadata for access control and ownership verification. Internal access is restricted to authorised personnel for operational needs only.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_UPLOADS_STORAGE_P2: You can delete your uploads at any time. When you delete a file, it is immediately removed from our storage systems and from our CDN cache. Any remaining copies that appear after deletion are the result of your own device or browser caching, which we cannot control.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_CONTENT_RESPONSIBILITY_BOD: Snipp.gg does not scan or analyse your uploads with third-party moderation tools. You are solely responsible for the content you share. Content that is unlawful, infringes intellectual property rights, or poses risks to others may be removed if reported or required by law, in accordance with our Terms of Service. We will respond to valid copyright infringement notices in accordance with applicable law. Contact {email}.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_HOW_WE_USE_ITEM_PROVIDE: To provide, maintain, and improve the Platform and its features.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_HOW_WE_USE_ITEM_AUTHENTICA: To authenticate users (e.g., via email magic link) and manage accounts and subscriptions.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_HOW_WE_USE_ITEM_PAYMENTS: To process payments and prevent fraud (via Stripe).
LEGAL_PRIVACY_HOW_WE_USE_ITEM_COMMUNICAT: To communicate service updates, security alerts, and transactional messages.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_HOW_WE_USE_ITEM_PREVENT_AB: To detect, investigate, and prevent abusive or illegal activities.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_HOW_WE_USE_ITEM_LEGAL: To comply with legal obligations and enforce our Terms of Service.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_THIRD_PARTIES_INTRO: We use trusted providers to run the Platform. These may include:
LEGAL_PRIVACY_PROCESSOR_CLOUDFLARE_TEXT: R2 object storage, CDN, DDoS protection, and related services.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_PROCESSOR_EMAIL_TEXT: Magic-link sign-in (we send a one-time link to your email).
LEGAL_PRIVACY_THIRD_PARTIES_NO_SALE: These providers process data on our behalf and only as necessary to deliver their services. We do not sell your personal information.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_DISCLOSURE_BODY: We may disclose information (i) to service providers as described above; (ii) to comply with applicable law, regulation, legal process, or governmental request; (iii) to enforce our Terms of Service; (iv) to protect the rights, property, or safety of us, our users, or the public; or (v) in connection with a corporate transaction (e.g., merger, acquisition), subject to appropriate safeguards.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_SECURITY_BODY: We use administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect your information. While we take reasonable steps to secure your data, no system can be guaranteed 100% secure, and transmission over the internet carries inherent risks.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_LAWFUL_BASIS_BODY: We process your personal data based on one or more of the following legal grounds: your consent, the performance of a contract, compliance with legal obligations, or our legitimate interests.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_INTERNATIONAL_TRANSFERS_BO: Your data may be stored or processed in countries outside the UK or EU, including in Cloudflare R2 data centers. When we transfer your personal data internationally, we use safeguards such as Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission to help ensure your data remains protected.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_YOUR_RIGHTS_BODY: If you are in the UK or EU, you have rights under the UK GDPR/EU GDPR, including the right to access, correct, or delete your data, and to object to or restrict certain processing. To exercise these rights, contact us at {email}.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_RELATED_POLICIES_GDPR: For details about your data rights under UK/EU law, see our {gdpr} page.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_CONTACT_SECURITY_ABUSE: To report security issues, email {security}. To report abuse or IP infringement, email {abuse}.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_CONTACT_QUESTIONS: Questions or concerns about this Policy? Email us at {email}.
LEGAL_PRIVACY_CHANGES_BODY: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes to our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. We will update the “Effective Date” above when we do so.

PLUS_PAGE_HERO_BODY: Upgrade to Snipp Plus for unlimited file sizes, custom embeds, an exclusive badge, and more. Enhance your screenshot and clip sharing experience.
PLUS_PAGE_FEATURE_NO_FILE_LIMIT_BODY: Upload files of any size. The 50 MB cap is gone. Single uploads can fill your full weekly quota, perfect for long gameplay, high-res artwork, and raw exports.
PLUS_PAGE_FEATURE_QUOTA_BODY: Upload up to 20 GB every rolling 7 days, 10x the free 2 GB allowance. Plenty of headroom for daily clips, screenshots, and big drops.
PLUS_PAGE_FEATURE_CUSTOM_EMBEDS_BODY: Personalize how your links appear on Discord, X, and other platforms. Set custom titles, descriptions, and colors.
PLUS_PAGE_FEATURE_BADGE_BODY: Stand out with a PLUS subscriber badge on your profile. Let everyone know you support Snipp and get exclusive perks.
PLUS_PAGE_FEATURE_EARLY_ACCESS_BODY: Be the first to try new features before they roll out to everyone. Your feedback shapes what we build next.
PLUS_PAGE_FEATURE_PRIORITY_SUPPORT_BODY: Get faster responses from our team when you need help. Making Snipp better for everyone is our top priority.
PLUS_PAGE_FEATURE_MORE_SOON_BODY: We're always cooking up new perks for PLUS members. Analytics, and more are on the way.
PLUS_PAGE_FAQ_COST_ANSWER: PLUS is $4.99/month or you can save with a yearly plan. We also offer promo codes from time to time. Not convinced? Use code GG for 100% off your first month!
PLUS_PAGE_FAQ_CANCEL_ANSWER: Absolutely. You can cancel your subscription at any time from your billing settings. No questions asked, no hidden fees. You'll keep your PLUS perks until the end of your billing period.
PLUS_PAGE_FAQ_UPLOADS_AFTER_CANCEL_QUEST: What happens to my uploads if I cancel?
PLUS_PAGE_FAQ_UPLOADS_AFTER_CANCEL_ANSWE: Your existing uploads stay exactly where they are, nothing gets deleted. You'll just go back to the free 50 MB upload limit for new uploads, which is still plenty for most use cases.
PLUS_PAGE_FAQ_WEEKLY_LIMIT_QUESTION: Is there a weekly upload limit?
PLUS_PAGE_FAQ_WEEKLY_LIMIT_ANSWER: Yes. Free accounts get 2 GB of uploads per rolling 7-day window. PLUS bumps that to 20 GB and removes the per-file size cap entirely. The window slides continuously, so quota frees up as your oldest uploads age past 7 days, no fixed reset day.
PLUS_PAGE_FAQ_FREE_TRIAL_ANSWER: Yes! New subscribers get a 5-day free trial when they upgrade. You can also use the promo code GG for 100% off your first month.
PLUS_PAGE_FAQ_NEED_PLUS_QUESTION: Do I need PLUS to use Snipp?
PLUS_PAGE_FAQ_NEED_PLUS_ANSWER: Not at all. Snipp is free forever and always will be. PLUS is for power users who want bigger uploads, custom embeds, and extra perks.
PLUS_PAGE_FAQ_REFUNDS_ANSWER: Yes, we do. If you're not satisfied with PLUS, just contact our support team within 7 days of your purchase and we'll issue a full refund.
PLUS_PAGE_HERO_SUBTITLE: Unlock unlimited file sizes, custom embeds, an exclusive profile badge, early access to new features, and so much more.
PLUS_PAGE_COMPARE_SUBTITLE: See the difference at a glance.
PLUS_PAGE_PRICING_PLUS_TAGLINE: A premium experience built for people who use Snipp the most.
PLUS_PAGE_FEATURE_NO_FILE_LIMIT_BODY_2: Go from 50 MB to no cap at all. Upload full gameplay recordings, 4K screenshots, raw exports, anything. Your weekly quota is the only limit.
PLUS_FEATURE_CUSTOM_EMBEDS_DESC: Make your links stand out. Customize how your uploads appear when shared on Discord, X, and other platforms. Only available to PLUS subscribers.
PLUS_EMBED_TITLE_HINT: Set a title that shows in the custom embed when your post link is shared.
PLUS_PAGE_FEATURE_CUSTOM_DESCRIPTIONS_BO: Add context to your custom embeds so people know what they're clicking. Custom variables are also supported.
PLUS_PAGE_FEATURE_CUSTOM_COLORS_BODY: Match the embed accent to your style or brand. Anything works!
PLUS_PAGE_SUPPORT_BODY: Snipp is built by a small team that cares about creating the best upload experience possible. Your subscription directly funds development.
PLUS_PAGE_SUPPORT_FUND_DEV_BODY: Every subscription helps us keep the lights on and ship new features faster.
PLUS_PAGE_SUPPORT_EARLY_ACCESS_BODY: PLUS members get early access to new features and their feedback directly influences what we build next.
PLUS_PAGE_SUPPORT_KEEP_FREE_BODY: Your support means we never have to run those annoying ads or sell user data. Snipp stays free for everyone.
PLUS_PAGE_FAQ_SUBTITLE: Everything you need to know about PLUS.
PLUS_PAGE_CTA_BODY: Try PLUS free for 5 days on us. Use code {code} for 100% off your first month. No risk involved, cancel anytime.
HOME_FAQ_FREE_ANSWER: Absolutely! Snipp is free for everyone. No ads, no nonsense. You can upgrade to PLUS to remove the per-file size cap and get other exclusive features. Give us a try using the code GG for 100% off your first month!
HOME_FAQ_SPEED_ANSWER: Snipp uses fast servers and a global CDN to ensure quick uploads no matter where you are.
HOME_FAQ_FILE_TYPES_QUESTION: What file types can I upload?
HOME_FAQ_FILE_TYPES_ANSWER: You can upload PNG, JPG, GIF, WEBP images and MP4, MOV, MKV videos, with more file types coming soon! If there's a file type you want to see supported, feel free to let us know!
HOME_FAQ_UPLOAD_SIZE_QUESTION: How large can my uploads be?
HOME_FAQ_UPLOAD_SIZE_ANSWER: Free users can upload files up to 50 MB per file with a 2 GB rolling weekly quota. PLUS users have no per-file cap and get a 20 GB weekly quota. Try PLUS free for 5 days when you upgrade, or use the code GG for 100% off your first month!
HOME_FAQ_DESKTOP_APP_ANSWER: Not yet, but we're working on it! Snipp works with ShareX (Windows) and XerahS (Mac) which can be downloaded for free. Check Settings -> Console after logging in to get started.
HOME_FAQ_PRIVACY_ANSWER: Uploads from the website are unlisted by default (link-only). You can make your post public at any time for your post to be seen on the Discover page, with private visibility also available when needed.
HOME_HERO_SUBTITLE: Upload screenshots and clips in seconds, and get an instant link to share. Just fast and simple sharing, built for gamers and creators.
HOME_STEPS_SUBTITLE: From uploading to sharing in seconds, it's just that simple.
HOME_STEP_UPLOAD_BODY: Drag & drop, paste, or click to upload your images and videos, and then watch the magic happen during processing.
HOME_STEP_LINK_BODY: Instantly receive a shareable link to your upload. You can make it public or keep it unlisted (private) with just a click.
HOME_STEP_SHARE_BODY: Paste the link on Discord, X (formerly Twitter *cough*), or anywhere else. Your content will load fast on any platform.
HOME_FEATURES_SUBTITLE: Everything you need to share your captures, nothing you don't.
HOME_FEATURE_FAST_BODY: Our global CDN ensures your uploads are shown instantly, anywhere in the world. (unless your post is private)
HOME_FEATURE_VISIBILITY_BODY: Website uploads are unlisted (link-only by default), with easy controls to make your post public or private whenever you want.
HOME_FEATURE_SHARING_BODY: Get a link instantly. Share anywhere. Compatible with ShareX (Windows) and XerahS (Mac) for simplified uploads.
HOME_STATS_UPLOAD_TIME_CAPTION: Fast uploads no matter where you are
HOME_MAP_BODY: Our CDN spans across the globe so your uploads always load instantly, no matter where your audience is located in the world. Map not drawn to scale.
HOME_MAP_EDGE_CAPTION: 300+ edge locations · <50ms average response time worldwide
HOME_SECURITY_AT_REST_BODY: We use industry-standard encryption so your files stay private and secure from the moment they leave your device until they reach their destination.
HOME_SECURITY_IN_TRANSIT_BODY: All uploads use TLS in transit and at rest so your data is encrypted from your browser to our servers.
HOME_SECURITY_STORAGE_BODY: Files are stored with strong encryption on redundant, secure infrastructure, with key rotations happening periodically.

SUPPORT_ACCOUNT_ISSUES_INTRO_P1: Having trouble with your account? Below are solutions to the most common issues. If none of these help, don't hesitate to reach out to our support team.
SUPPORT_ACCOUNT_ISSUES_LOGIN_ITEM_SPAM_F: If you're not receiving magic link emails, check your spam or junk folder. Some email providers may delay delivery by a few minutes.
SUPPORT_ACCOUNT_ISSUES_LOGIN_ITEM_SAME_A: Make sure you're using the same email address or Discord account you originally signed up with.
SUPPORT_ACCOUNT_ISSUES_LOGIN_ITEM_CLEAR_: Try clearing your browser cache and cookies, then attempt to sign in again. Using a private or incognito window can also help isolate the issue.
SUPPORT_ACCOUNT_ISSUES_PROFILE_ITEM_CHAN: If your profile changes aren't saving, try refreshing the page and making the changes again. Ensure your image files are under the size limit.
SUPPORT_ACCOUNT_ISSUES_PROFILE_ITEM_USER: Username changes may take a few moments to appear across the platform. If your old username still shows up, give it a minute and refresh.
SUPPORT_ACCOUNT_ISSUES_PROFILE_ITEM_AVAT: If your avatar or banner isn't updating, try uploading a different image to rule out a format issue. We support PNG, JPG, GIF, and WebP.
SUPPORT_ACCOUNT_ISSUES_UPLOAD_ITEM_TIER_: If uploads are failing, check your account tier limits. Free accounts have a 50 MB per-file cap. PLUS has no per-file cap, but every upload must fit within your remaining weekly quota.
SUPPORT_ACCOUNT_ISSUES_UPLOAD_ITEM_FORMA: Make sure the file format is supported. Snipp accepts most common image, video, audio, document, and archive formats.
SUPPORT_ACCOUNT_ISSUES_UPLOAD_ITEM_SLOW_: Slow or unstable internet connections can cause uploads to time out. Try again on a stronger connection, or use a smaller file to test.

SUPPORT_SECURITY_META_DESCRIPTION: Report security vulnerabilities to Snipp responsibly. Review bug bounty guidelines, scope, rewards, and disclosure expectations.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_INTRO_P1: We're committed to making Snipp the best it can be, and that means squashing bugs quickly. If you've encountered an issue or discovered something that isn't working quite right, we want to know about it! We appreciate every contribution—happy hunting!
SUPPORT_SECURITY_COMMITMENT_P1: We will never pursue legal action against anyone who reports vulnerabilities in good faith and follows the guidelines on this page.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_COMMITMENT_P2: We aim to acknowledge every report within 48 hours and will keep you updated throughout the resolution process.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_COMMITMENT_P3: Depending on the severity and impact of your finding, you may be eligible for an exclusive profile badge and free months of our PLUS subscription.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_BADGES_P1: Researchers who make meaningful contributions to Snipp's security can earn profile badges displayed publicly on their account.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_BADGES_BUG_HUNTER: Awarded after 3-5 exceptional bug reports. Demonstrates consistent contributions to Snipp's user experience and security.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_BADGES_ELITE_BUG_HUNTER: Awarded for discovering vulnerabilities or submitting critical reports. Reserved for active researchers who uncover the most impactful issues.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_GUIDELINES_ITEM_OWN_ACC: All testing must be performed on your own accounts. Never interact with or impact other users' data or accounts.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_GUIDELINES_ITEM_SNIPP_O: Only Snipp-operated services are in scope. Reports targeting third-party platforms, even those integrated via our API, will not be accepted.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_GUIDELINES_ITEM_NO_SERV: Avoid any activity that could degrade our services or compromise data integrity—this includes brute forcing, DoS, spamming, and timing-based attacks.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_GUIDELINES_ITEM_NO_AUTO: Automated scanning tools are not allowed. All testing should be done manually.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_GUIDELINES_ITEM_TEMP_SC: We may temporarily exclude certain vulnerability classes from scope while we address them internally. Any changes will be reflected on this page.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_GUIDELINES_ITEM_KEEP_CO: Please keep all findings confidential until we've fully investigated and resolved the issue.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_HANDLING_P1: Responsible disclosure is the best way to help us fix issues quickly while minimizing risk. When you report directly to us, we can begin working on a fix immediately without exposing the vulnerability to bad actors.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_HANDLING_P2: Findings that are shared publicly before we've had a chance to address them—whether on social media, forums, or anywhere else—will not be eligible for badge recognition. We want to credit the people who give us the opportunity to fix things first.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_HANDLING_DUPLICATES_INT: If multiple people report the same issue, we'll evaluate submissions based on:
SUPPORT_SECURITY_HANDLING_DUPLICATES_ITE: How well the report conveys the real-world impact
SUPPORT_SECURITY_HANDLING_P3: We genuinely appreciate every researcher who takes the time to help make Snipp safer.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_INTRO: Before submitting, think about whether the issue has a realistic attack scenario and a meaningful security impact. The following are generally excluded:
SUPPORT_SECURITY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_ITEM_MITM_: Attacks requiring MITM or physical access to a user's device
SUPPORT_SECURITY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_ITEM_DOS: Denial of Service attacks where the outcome is resource exhaustion
SUPPORT_SECURITY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_ITEM_EMAIL: Email SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records
SUPPORT_SECURITY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_ITEM_SCANN: Reports from scanners and automated tools
SUPPORT_SECURITY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_ITEM_SELF_: Self-exploitation (like token reuse and console scripting)
SUPPORT_SECURITY_OUT_OF_SCOPE_ITEM_SOCIA: Social engineering or phishing attacks targeting users or staff
SUPPORT_SECURITY_NOTES_THIRD_PARTY_BODY: External services, partners, and integrations are outside the scope of this program. Only vulnerabilities in Snipp-owned features and APIs qualify. Reports must show a clear security impact to Snipp itself.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_NOTES_TOKEN_THEFT_BODY: Any scenario where an attacker could obtain another user's API keys, session tokens, or credentials without relying on social engineering is considered in scope.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_NOTES_CRASHES_BODY: Reproducible website crashes caused by crafted input or normal user interaction are considered in scope, provided they do not depend on resource exhaustion, spam, or other denial-of-service techniques.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_NOTES_RACE_CONDITIONS_I: Reports that depend on exploiting a race condition need additional evidence to be accepted. Please include at least one of the following:
A reproducible script (Python or JavaScript preferred, though other languages are fine)
A thorough writeup covering the HTTP methods, endpoints, and exact request ordering needed to trigger the condition
SUPPORT_SECURITY_NOTES_RACE_CONDITIONS_P: Including a script makes it much easier for us to verify the issue and speeds up the review process.
SUPPORT_SECURITY_CTA_BODY: Send us an email with a clear description of the issue, steps to reproduce, and any supporting evidence. We'll get back to you as soon as we can.
SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_META_DESCRIPTION: How Snipp's rolling weekly upload quota works, what counts toward it, and the limits for Free, PLUS, and Enterprise accounts.
SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_INTRO_P1: Snipp caps how much you can upload in any rolling 7-day window. This keeps service fast for everyone and prevents abuse, while still leaving plenty of room for normal use.
SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_PLAN_QUOTAS_ITEM_F: 2 GB total uploads per rolling 7 days, with a 50 MB cap per file.
SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_PLAN_QUOTAS_ITEM_P: 20 GB per rolling 7 days, no per-file cap. That's 10x the free weekly allowance, and a single upload can fill the whole quota.
SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_PLAN_QUOTAS_ITEM_E: 50 GB per rolling 7 days, no per-file cap.
SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_ROLLING_WINDOW_ITE: Your quota is calculated over the last 7 days from right now, not a fixed Monday-to-Sunday week. There's no single reset day.
As an upload ages past 7 days, its size automatically frees up. Quota recovers continuously throughout the week.
Example: if you upload 1 GB on Monday and 500 MB on Wednesday, that 1 GB stops counting next Monday, freeing up headroom even though the 500 MB is still inside the window.
SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_WHAT_COUNTS_ITEM_A: Every successful upload counts: website, API, ShareX, and XerahS. Public, unlisted, and private posts all count the same.
Albums count as the sum of their files. A 5-file album of 200 MB each uses 1 GB of quota.
SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_WHAT_COUNTS_ITEM_F: Failed or rejected uploads (rate-limited, virus-flagged, moderated) do not consume quota.
SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_WHAT_COUNTS_ITEM_D: Deleting a post does not refund its quota. The window only releases bytes by aging out, not by deletion.
SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_HITTING_LIMIT_ITEM: When you're out of quota, new uploads return a "Weekly usage limit exceeded" error with the timestamp when your next chunk frees up.
SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_HITTING_LIMIT_P1_B: Check your live usage and the countdown to your next refill from
SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_HITTING_LIMIT_P2_A: applies your higher quota immediately, including the existing usage you've already accumulated.
SUPPORT_WEEKLY_LIMITS_CTA_BODY: Running a project that needs more than 50 GB per week? Reach out and we'll work out a plan that fits.
